notes.title: Mimpi Dreams sale and update!
notes.notes:
We just updated Mimpi Dreams with a new level for free and also with it a new costume and 4 achievements.

To celebrate the update there will be a 30% discount on Mimpi Dreams starting tomorrow! :mimpiface:

notes.title: Challenge Mode update for Mimpi Dreams!
notes.notes:
Now you can challenge yourself and your friends in Mimpi Dreams to see who can get further in the game with only one life!

Will you be able to beat the game and get the achievement? :CuriousMimpi:
